entry.title: dotnet/maui - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-11-14
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Combining MauiAndroidSystemBarsUseMauiChrome, Material3 and theme switching on Android Hides Status Bar Icons #40262
  • [Spec] Span.TextDecorationColor / TextDecorationThickness: underline / strikethrough in its own colour and thickness #40259
  • [aw] Daily Memory Leak Hunter reported incomplete result #40251
  • [repo-status] Daily repo status — 2026-11-14: cross-platform fixes and servicing progress #40244
  • [aw] Daily Memory Leak Hunter is missing required data #40241

Closed

  • [repo-status] Daily repo status — 2026-11-13 🌟 #40207

PullRequests

Created

  • [Android] Keep SoftInput test geometry valid on small displays #40264
  • [SourceGen] Fix xmlns prefix expansion and TypedBinding emission in C# expressions #40263
    community ✨
  • [Android] Don't show the keyboard when a read-only input is focused from code #40261
    platform/android, community ✨, area-keyboard
  • Add Span.TextDecorationColor and TextDecorationThickness (underline / strikethrough color and thickness) #40260
    s/agent-gate-passed
  • [CI] Add /review run-tests to run only affected UI and device tests #40253

Merged

  • [Android] Limit animated SoftInput padding to the keyboard overlap #40256
    community ✨
  • [Android] Don't animate the Shell item pager when switching Shell items #40255
    community ✨
  • [iOS] Guard NavigationRenderer status bar queries before the first page is set #40254
    community ✨
  • [Testing] Preserve scroll offset during CollectionView infinite loading #40258
  • [Testing] Enable metadata updates in Helix unit-test work items #40252
  • Add news entry for .NET MAUI in 2026 #40257
  • [Shell] Recompute relative pops after awaiting pending navigations #40183
    platform/android, area-controls-shell, community ✨, s/agent-gate-passed
  • Clear the modal root page's toolbar when NavigationPage detaches #40184
    community ✨, s/agent-gate-passed
  • [iOS] Keep Shell tab switches from flashing the default white canvas #40221
    platform/macos, platform/ios, area-controls-shell, community ✨
  • [XSG] Add Hot Reload regression tests for nested content containers (#36256) #40231
  • [XSG] XIHR: recover from rude edits that fail to compile #40235
  • [XSG] Resolve StyleSheet Source resource path at compile time #40250
    community ✨
  • [Testing] End AppInfo predecessor setup before checking collection #40246
  • [Testing] Correct iOS 18.5 landscape SearchBar keyboard baseline #40245
  • [iOS] Stabilize Shell clear-icon screenshot caret state #40247
  • [Android][Testing] Keep Issue7556 flyout actions reachable #40248
  • [Android] Avoid keyboard on programmatic read-only focus #40249

Updated

  • [Release candidate] 11.0.1xx SR2 #40116
  • [Android] Fix Label LineHeight adding extra space below the first line #40188
    platform/android, community ✨, area-controls-label
  • [Shell] Make global route matching independent of registration order #40182
    community ✨, s/agent-gate-passed
  • Move main to .NET 12 #40060
    s/agent-gate-failed
  • [net12] Add ScrollAnchorMode to keep the start or end of a CollectionView in view #40211
    do-not-merge
  • [release/10.0.1xx-sr14] .NET 10 SR14 (10.0.140) #40222
    s/agent-gate-passed
  • [WIP][Android] Fix for LongPressGestureRecognizer fires after a plain tap when it is the only gesture on the view #40229
    platform/android, community ✨, area-gestures, partner/syncfusion
